gloss: strikingly beautiful; having a fine appearance

definitions.gloss: strikingly beautiful; having graceful features and figure
definitions.explanation: Describes a person whose face and overall appearance are exceptionally beautiful and elegant. A formal, literary expression often used in writing.

examples.japanese: {容姿端麗|ようしたんれい}な{女性|じょせい}だ。
examples.english: She is a strikingly beautiful woman.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{容姿端麗|ようしたんれい}で{成績|せいせき}も{優秀|ゆうしゅう}だ。
examples.english: He is good-looking and has excellent grades.

examples.japanese: {容姿端麗|ようしたんれい}なだけでなく、{性格|せいかく}もとても{良|よ}い{人|ひと}だ。
examples.english: Not only is she strikingly beautiful, but she also has a wonderful personality.

notes:
USAGE:
A {四字熟語|よじじゅくご} (four-character compound) that describes someone with outstanding physical beauty. {容姿|ようし} means appearance or figure, and {端麗|たんれい} means graceful or refined. Used as a na-adjective modifying nouns ({容姿端麗|ようしたんれい}な{人|ひと}) or as a predicate. More formal and literary than simply saying きれい or {美|うつく}しい.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {容姿端麗|ようしたんれい}な{人|ひと} (a strikingly beautiful person)
- {頭脳明晰|ずのうめいせき}{容姿端麗|ようしたんれい} (brilliant mind and beautiful appearance)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {美人|びじん}: a beautiful person — more everyday and casual
- {端正|たんせい}な: well-proportioned, refined — describes neat, balanced features
